items.difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-complex-and-divisor the lemma produces a morphism b : X' -> X which is unique with the properties that the pullback D' = b^{-1}D is defined with (X', D', Lb^*M) a good triple, and that every h : Y -> X for which h^{-1}D is defined and (Y, h^{-1}D, Lh^*M) is a good triple factors uniquely through b; moreover on an affine chart (U, A, f, M^bullet) the restriction of b is the blowing up in the product of the ideals I_i(M^bullet, f), and on a quasi-compact open W it is a W minus D-admissible blowing up (statement lines 13587-13603). The construction blows up each affine chart U in the finitely generated product ideal I = prod_i I_i(M^bullet, f), notes that b_U^{-1}(U cap D) is defined by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-blow-up-pullback-effective-Cartier, that f^{r_i} lies in I_i hence b_U is U minus D-admissible, and that b_U factors through each individual blowup in I_i by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-blowing-up-two-ideals, so that the pullbacks of the I_i become invertible and (U', b^{-1}D, Lb^*M|_U) is a good triple by Lemma labelled lemma-pullback-triple-ideals-good (proof lines 13605-13636). The universal property over U is then checked by covering Y by affine charts where the ideals I_i(N^bullet, g) are invertible, using that the images of f and g differ by a unit and More on Algebra, Lemmas labelled more-algebra-lemma-eta-change-unit and more-algebra-lemma-ideal-well-defined to identify the ideals, after which the classical universal property of a blowup (Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-universal-property-blowing-up) gives the unique factorization (proof lines 13638-13662). The charts glue: the local morphisms agree on overlaps by the universal property, satisfy the cocycle condition, and descend to b : X' -> X by Constructions, Lemma labelled constructions-lemma-relative-glueing (proof lines 13664-13685); the final assertion on a quasi-compact W is proved by a finite affine cover, gluing the corrected ideals I_{t,i} = f_t^{N_i - sum_{j >= i} (-1)^{j - i} rk(M_t^j)} I_i(M_t^bullet, f_t) into finite type ideals I_i on W (proof lines 13687-13714). Two routine steps are dismissed as 'details omitted' (proof lines 13665 and 13681). Gluing the local blowups through their universal property and correcting the ideals so that they patch is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
